metadata.title: GridWise ULTIMA-50 — 50 Hardest & Most Adversarial Test Cases
metadata.description: 50 cutting-edge adversarial tests covering double negations, fractional losses, midnight boundary wraps, MW/kVA unit conversions, counterfactuals, dialects (Sadhu, Sylheti, Chittagonian, Dhakaiya, Barisal), SCADA machine noise, and interlocking multi-note puzzles.

test_cases.title: Double Negation on Battery Discharge Permission
operator_notes: Under no circumstances should the battery be prevented from discharging between 2 PM and 6 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: Double negation: 'not prevented from discharging' means discharging is permitted. No restrictive directive.

test_cases.title: Negated Prohibition on Grid Draw
operator_notes: It is strictly not forbidden to import grid power up to 90 kWh between 6 PM and 10 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: Positive allowance up to 90 kWh means grid is capped at 90 kWh.

test_cases.title: Double Negative Reserve Obligation ('Do not fail to maintain')
operator_notes: Do not fail to maintain a minimum 160 kWh battery reserve between 17:00 and 21:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 'Do not fail to maintain' is a mandatory directive to keep 160 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Never-Active Charging Restriction
operator_notes: Ensure that battery cell charging is at no point active between 10:00 and 13:00.

expected_directives.explanation: Charging never active = no_charge_window between 10:00 and 13:00.

test_cases.title: Double Negative Modal of Obligation ('Cannot afford not to curtail')
operator_notes: With the inverter overheating, we cannot afford not to curtail solar generation by 60% from 11 AM to 2 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: 'Cannot afford not to curtail by 60%' = curtail by 60% -> remaining factor 0.40.

test_cases.title: Vulgar Fraction Loss ('Five-Eighths Lost')
operator_notes: Heavy particulate soiling has caused five-eighths of our solar generation potential to be lost from 11:00 to 14:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 5/8 lost = 3/8 remaining (factor 0.375) between 11:00 and 14:00.

test_cases.title: Compound Sub-Array Weighted Derating
operator_notes: Array A (40% capacity) loses 75% output, while Array B (60% capacity) loses 25% output between 12:00 and 15:00.

test_cases.title: Precise Derating to Three-Sixteenths
operator_notes: Severe shading from the new academic building limits rooftop solar to three-sixteenths of nominal rating from 13:00 to 16:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 3/16 = 0.1875 remaining factor from 1 PM to 4 PM.

test_cases.title: Extreme Percentage Plunge ('Plummets by 92.5%')
operator_notes: Catastrophic dust storm: rooftop solar production plummets by 92.5 percent between 10 AM and 1 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: Plummets by 92.5% leaves 7.5% (factor 0.075).

test_cases.title: Ratio Divisor Derating ('2.5 Times Lower Than Normal')
operator_notes: Atmospheric smog will keep midday solar generation 2.5 times lower than normal from noon to 3 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: 2.5 times lower = 1 / 2.5 = 0.40 factor.

test_cases.title: Fractional Battery Reserve ('Seven-Tenths of Capacity')
operator_notes: Emergency grid alert: retain seven-tenths of total battery capacity in reserve between 18:00 and 22:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 7/10 of 400 kWh = 280 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Exact Fractional Reserve ('17.5% of Capacity')
operator_notes: Maintain a baseline reserve equal to exactly 17.5% of battery storage capacity throughout the evening (17:00 to 21:00).

expected_directives.explanation: 17.5% of 400 kWh = 70.0 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Vulgar Fraction Reserve ('Three-Eighths of Full Capacity')
operator_notes: Reserve buffer must equal three-eighths of full battery energy capacity between 19:00 and 23:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 3/8 of 400 kWh = 150.0 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Asymmetric Midnight Span (4h Before to 3h After)
operator_notes: Substation transformer cooling: prohibit battery charging from 4 hours before midnight until 3 hours after midnight.

expected_directives.explanation: 20:00 to 03:00 wraps across midnight -> sorted [0, 1, 2, 20, 21, 22, 23].

test_cases.title: Fractional Midnight Straddle (23:30 to 03:30)
operator_notes: Nighttime cable splicing requires no battery discharge between 23:30 and 03:30.

expected_directives.explanation: Hourly mapping covering the overnight window -> [0, 1, 2, 23].

test_cases.title: Duration-Based Overnight Span (22:00 for 7 Hours)
operator_notes: Substation maintenance begins at 22:00 and lasts for 7 consecutive hours, during which grid import cannot exceed 60 kWh.

test_cases.title: Short Midnight Straddle (11 PM to 1 AM)
operator_notes: Block battery discharging from 11 PM to 1 AM.

expected_directives.explanation: 11 PM (hour 23) to 1 AM (hour 0) -> sorted [0, 23].

test_cases.title: Overnight Sunrise Span (10 PM to 6 AM)
operator_notes: Overnight charging freeze starting at 10 PM and running until 6 AM.

test_cases.title: Terminal Hour Horizon (23:00 to 00:00)
operator_notes: Single-hour boundary: battery discharge is prohibited strictly from 23:00 to 00:00.

expected_directives.explanation: Hour 23 only.

test_cases.title: Origin Hour Horizon (00:00 to 01:00)
operator_notes: Beginning at 00:00 midnight and ending at 01:00, cap grid import at 50 kWh.

expected_directives.explanation: Hour 0 only.

test_cases.title: Megawatt to Hourly kWh Conversion (0.12 MW)
operator_notes: Limit total campus grid intake to 0.12 MW per hour between 18:00 and 22:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 0.12 MW = 120 kW = 120 kWh per hour.

test_cases.title: kVA at Power Factor to Active Power kW
operator_notes: Transformer feeder T-1 apparent power cap is 100 kVA at 0.90 lagging power factor between 17:00 and 21:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 100 kVA * 0.90 = 90 kW = 90 kWh/h active power limit.

test_cases.title: Megawatt-Hour to kWh Battery Reserve (0.18 MWh)
operator_notes: Battery cells must retain at least 0.18 MWh in reserve between 18:00 and 22:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 0.18 MWh = 180 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Watt-Hours to kWh Grid Limit (85,000 Wh)
operator_notes: Grid import cannot exceed 85,000 Watt-hours in any hour between 19:00 and 22:00.

test_cases.title: Substation MW Feeder Ceiling (0.075 MW)
operator_notes: No grid intake beyond 0.075 MW from 18:00 to 21:00 due to overhead line sag.

test_cases.title: Watt-Hour Reserve Buffer (160,000 Wh)
operator_notes: Maintain stored energy strictly above 160,000 Wh between 17:00 and 20:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 160,000 Wh = 160.0 kWh reserve.

test_cases.title: Counterfactual Frequency Drop Trap
operator_notes: Had the grid frequency dipped below 49.5 Hz we would have capped grid import at 60 kWh, but frequency remained steady at 50 Hz today.

expected_directives.explanation: Counterfactual statement with unmet condition. No operational directive.

test_cases.title: Rejected Shift Proposal
operator_notes: The junior technician suggested keeping 200 kWh reserve tonight. That idea was formally rejected during the 4 PM shift briefing.

expected_directives.explanation: Explicitly rejected suggestion. Standard operations apply (no_op).

test_cases.title: Mid-Sentence Cancellation and Replacement
operator_notes: Initially we mandated zero charging from 1 PM to 4 PM, but disregard that completely; however, rooftop panel cleaning from 10 AM to 1 PM will halve generation.

expected_directives.explanation: Charging ban was retracted; confirmed directive is solar cleaning 10 AM-1 PM factor 0.5.

test_cases.title: Reinstated Dispatch Order
operator_notes: We had revoked the 7 PM to 10 PM grid cap, but the chief dispatcher just re-issued it: strictly keep grid intake below 90 units.

expected_directives.explanation: Grid cap re-issued: 7 PM to 10 PM max 90 units.

test_cases.title: If-and-Only-If Unmet Threshold
operator_notes: If and only if the substation transformer oil temp exceeds 75C should you cap grid at 70 kWh. Oil temp is currently nominal at 38C.

expected_directives.explanation: Condition (temp > 75C) was not met. No directive applies.

test_cases.title: Deferred Testing Maintenance Notice
operator_notes: Do not implement the scheduled 2 PM to 5 PM charging pause as testing has been deferred to next month.

expected_directives.explanation: Testing was deferred to next month. No directive for today.

test_cases.title: Rumor Debunking Notice
operator_notes: Staff notice: please disregard any rumors regarding limiting campus grid import today; substation runs under normal limits.

expected_directives.explanation: Debunking rumor; standard operations continue (no_op).

test_cases.title: Informational Tariff Outlook
operator_notes: Energy commission briefing: national grid peak surcharge will rise by 15% starting next fiscal year.

expected_directives.explanation: Future tariff news with no action for today's 24-hour dispatch schedule.

test_cases.title: Code-Switching Transformer Hazard Window
operator_notes: Transformer overheating risk er jonno shondha 6:30 theke raat 9:30 porjonto grid theke 85 unit er beshi import kora strictly prohibited.

expected_directives.explanation: Evening window 18:00 to 22:00 max grid 85 kWh.

test_cases.title: Sadhu Bhasha Formal Discharge Embargo
operator_notes: অদ্য অপরাহ্ন ৩ ঘটিকা হইতে অপরাহ্ন ৬ ঘটিকা পর্যন্ত ব্যাটারি হইতে বিদ্যুৎ নিঃসরণ সম্পূর্ণরূপে নিষিদ্ধ থাকিবে।

expected_directives.explanation: 3 PM to 6 PM (hours 15, 16, 17) no discharge in formal Sadhu Bengali.

test_cases.title: Sylheti Overnight Charge Freeze
operator_notes: আইজকা রাইত এগারোটা অইতে বিয়ান তিনটা তক ব্যাটারি চার্জ করন পুরাপুরি বন্ধ রাখবা।

expected_directives.explanation: 11 PM to 3 AM in Sylheti dialect = hours [0, 1, 2, 23] no charge.

test_cases.title: Chittagonian Midday Solar Wash
operator_notes: সোলার প্যানেল পরিষ্কার চলিবু দুপুর বারোটা তন তিনটা, উৎপাদন আড়াই আনা (২৫%) অইবো।

expected_directives.explanation: Chittagonian dialect 12 to 3 PM solar factor 0.25.

test_cases.title: Dhakaiya Kutti Evening Discharge Lock
operator_notes: আরে ভাই, সন্ধ্যা ৭টা থেইকা রাত ১০টা তক ব্যাটারির কোনো ডিসচার্জ হইবো না, একদম ফুল লক।

expected_directives.explanation: Dhakaiya dialect 7 PM to 10 PM no battery discharge.

test_cases.title: Barisal Dialect Night Grid Cap
operator_notes: আইজগো রাইত ৮টা অইতে ১০টা তক গ্রিড দিয়া ৭০ ইউনিটের বেশি আনা যাইবে না।

expected_directives.explanation: Barisal dialect 8 PM to 10 PM max grid 70 kWh.

test_cases.title: Military Time Banglish Solar Dip
operator_notes: 0900 theke 1300 hours porjonto solar output e 60% dip ashbe dust storm er karone.

expected_directives.explanation: 09:00 to 13:00 dip by 60% = factor 0.40.

test_cases.title: Banglish Disjoint Charging Block
operator_notes: Dupur 12-2pm and shondha 6-8pm battery charging bondho thakbe.

expected_directives.explanation: Disjoint hours [12, 13, 18, 19] no charging.

test_cases.title: Tri-Directive Chained Continuity Puzzle
operator_notes: Solar washing from 11 AM to 2 PM reduces PV yield to 30%.
Prohibit battery discharge from 2 PM to 5 PM.
Cap grid intake at 115 kWh from 5 PM to 9 PM.

test_cases.title: Reserve Buffer with Interleaved Cafeteria Distractor
operator_notes: Maintain at least 150 kWh battery storage reserve between 18:00 and 22:00.
Cafeteria menu committee will convene in room 204 at 1 PM tomorrow.
No battery charging permitted from 14:00 to 17:00.

test_cases.title: Complementary Two-Stage Solar Degradation
operator_notes: Morning haze reduces solar harvest by 30% between 09:00 and 12:00.
Afternoon dust storm leaves solar operating at only 30% of nominal capacity from 12:00 to 15:00.

test_cases.title: Double Distractor Sandwiching Real Substation Limit
operator_notes: Vice Chancellor announced expansion of campus renewable microgrid research wing.
Substation thermal limit: grid import must not exceed 95 units per hour from 18:00 to 21:00.
Student council voting will be conducted in the sports complex this evening.

test_cases.title: Concurrent Reserve and Discharge Lock During Same Hours
operator_notes: Hold at least 175 kWh in battery reserve between 18:00 and 22:00.
Block all battery discharging during those exact same evening hours, 18:00 to 22:00.

test_cases.title: Telemetry SCADA Alarm Format Pair
operator_notes: [SCADA_EVENT_10:15] INVERTER_WARNING: Rooftop array derating to 40% between 11:00 and 14:00.
[SCADA_EVENT_16:30] FEEDER_ALERT: Substation T-1 import constrained to 80 kWh from 18:00 to 21:00.

test_cases.title: Dual Midnight Straddle Interaction
operator_notes: Overnight charging ban: avoid battery charging from 10 PM to 2 AM.
Nighttime grid cap: limit grid import to 65 kWh from 11 PM to 4 AM.

test_cases.title: The Grand Finale — Tri-Channel Orchestration
operator_notes: Midday dust accumulation brings solar generation down to one-fourth between 11:00 and 14:00.
Preserve evening storage buffer: maintain at least 160 kWh in reserve from 17:00 to 21:00.
National grid transmission corridor constraint: cap grid intake at 120 kWh per hour from 18:00 to 22:00.
